definitions.gloss: exchange of gifts; gift-giving; presenting and receiving gifts
definitions.explanation: The formal practice of giving and receiving gifts, especially as part of social customs and seasonal traditions.

examples.japanese: {贈答|ぞうとう}{品|ひん}を{選|えら}ぶ。
お{歳暮|せいぼ}は{日本|にほん}の{贈答|ぞうとう}{文化|ぶんか}のひとつだ。
examples.english: Year-end gifts are part of Japan's gift-giving culture.

examples.japanese: {贈答|ぞうとう}にふさわしい{高級|こうきゅう}な{和菓子|わがし}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for premium Japanese sweets suitable for gift-giving.

notes:
Combines {贈|おく}る (to give) and {答|こた}える (to respond/return), reflecting the reciprocal nature of Japanese gift-giving. A formal word — used in commerce and cultural discussions rather than casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {贈答|ぞうとう}{品|ひん}: gift item
- {贈答|ぞうとう}{用|よう}: for gift-giving purposes
- {贈答|ぞうとう}{文化|ぶんか}: gift-giving culture
- {贈答|ぞうとう}シーズン: gift-giving season

GIFT-GIVING SEASONS:
- お{中元|ちゅうげん}: mid-year gifts (summer)
- お{歳暮|せいぼ}: year-end gifts (winter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プレゼント: present (casual, personal)
- {贈|おく}り{物|もの}: gift (general)
- {贈答|ぞうとう} emphasizes the formal, reciprocal custom of exchanging gifts
